candidate.description: Launch the first 191 selected-down output tiles through the unchanged local128 weighted owner, then launch only the final 16-column tile at local256. The last of its ten route producers executes the exact retained wave-0 D9 aggregate/residual/next-RMSNorm tree with 256 physical lanes.
candidate.control_sequence: one local128 selected-down+weighted launch, then one local256 D9 launch
candidate.candidate_sequence: one 191-tile local128 selected-down+weighted launch, then one ten-block local256 final-tile selected-down+weighted+D9 launch

red_green.red: The focused natural-shape fixture failed collection because the Q4 and planar-Q6 final-tile local256 wrappers did not exist.
red_green.green: Both candidates matched the retained selected rows, routed output, hidden output, normalized output, and self-resetting completion counters bit-for-bit.

protocol.workload: actual Laguna layer-10 Q4 and layer-1 planar-Q6 E256/K1024/N3072/top-10 selected-down plus D9
protocol.timing: 21 counterbalanced HIP-event samples, each the average of 100 sequences, after five warmups
protocol.command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_selected_natural_decode_leaf.py --gate-candidate tile8-parallel-silu-interleaved --down-candidate lasttile256-moe-tail --warmups 5 --samples 21 --burst 100 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-selected-down-lasttile256-moe-tail-leaf.json

decision.result: reject and remove before runtime integration
decision.reason: Splitting the producer grid and running the final ten route blocks at local256 costs more than the standalone local256 D9 launch for both natural weight families.
decision.closed_seam: Selected-down-integrated D9 is now rejected both as one local128 producer grid with two logical tail lanes per thread and as a split local128/local256 final-tile owner. Reopen only with a genuinely different consumer or persistent-execution design.
